classes.label: Catalog
classes.comment: A curated collection of metadata about resources (e.g., datasets and data services in the context of a data catalog).

classes.label: Catalog Record
classes.comment: 1つのデータセットを記述したデータ・カタログ内のレコード。

classes.label: Data service
classes.comment: A site or end-point providing operations related to the discovery of, access to, or processing functions on, data or related resources.

classes.label: Conjunto de datos
classes.comment: 1つのエージェントによって公開またはキュレートされ、1つ以上の形式でアクセスまたはダウンロードできるデータの集合。

classes.label: Dataset series
classes.comment: A collection of datasets that are published separately, but share some characteristics that group them.

classes.label: Distribuce
classes.comment: A specific representation of a dataset. A dataset might be available in multiple serializations that may differ in various ways, including natural language, media-type or format, schematic organization, temporal and spatial resolution, level of detail or profiles (which might specify any or all of the above).

classes.label: Relación
classes.comment: An association class for attaching additional information to a relationship between DCAT Resources.

classes.label: Catalogued resource
classes.comment: Recurso publicado o curado por un agente único.

classes.label: Rol
classes.comment: A role is the function of a resource or agent with respect to another resource, in the context of resource attribution or resource relationships.

properties.label: data access service
properties.comment: A site or end-point that gives access to the distribution of the dataset.

properties.label: URL d'accès
properties.comment: A URL of a resource that gives access to a distribution of the dataset. E.g. landing page, feed, SPARQL endpoint. Use for all cases except a simple download link, in which case downloadURL is preferred.

properties.label: bounding box
properties.comment: El cuadro delimitador geográfico para un recurso.

properties.label: byte size
properties.comment: El tamaño de una distribución en bytes.

properties.label: catalog
properties.comment: A catalog that is listed in the catalog.

properties.label: centroid
properties.comment: El centro geográfico (centroide) de un recurso.

properties.label: compression format
properties.comment: El formato de la distribución en el que los datos están en forma comprimida, e.g. para reducir el tamaño del archivo a bajar.

properties.label: Punto de contacto
properties.comment: Información relevante de contacto para el recurso catalogado. Se recomienda el uso de vCard.

properties.label: conjunto de datos
properties.comment: A dataset that is listed in the catalog.

properties.label: distribuce
properties.comment: An available distribution of the dataset.

properties.label: URL de descarga
properties.comment: Ceci est un lien direct à un fichier téléchargeable en un format donnée. Exple fichier CSV ou RDF. Le format est décrit par les propriétés de distribution dcterms:format et/ou dcat:mediaType.

properties.label: datum konce
properties.comment: El fin del período.

properties.label: descripción del end-point del servicio
properties.comment: A description of the service end-point, including its operations, parameters etc.

properties.label: end-point del servicio
properties.comment: Kořenové umístění nebo hlavní přístupový bod služby (IRI přístupné přes Web).

properties.label: first
properties.comment: The first resource in an ordered collection or series of resources, to which the current resource belongs.

properties.label: has current version
properties.comment: This resource has a more specific, versioned resource with equivalent content [PAV].

properties.label: has version
properties.comment: This resource has a more specific, versioned resource [PAV].

properties.label: haRuolo
properties.comment: Funkce entity či agenta ve vztahu k jiné entitě či zdroji.

properties.label: in series
properties.comment: A dataset series of which the dataset is part.

properties.label: keyword
properties.comment: A keyword or tag describing a resource.

properties.label: landing page
properties.comment: A Web page that can be navigated to in a Web browser to gain access to the catalog, a dataset, its distributions and/or additional information.

properties.label: last
properties.comment: The last resource in an ordered collection or series of resources, to which the current resource belongs.

properties.label: media type
properties.comment: Cette propriété doit être utilisée quand c'est définit le type de média de la distribution en IANA, sinon dcterms:format DOIT être utilisé avec différentes valeurs.

properties.label: formato de empaquetado
properties.comment: Balíčkový formát souboru, ve kterém je jeden či více souborů seskupeno dohromady, např. aby bylo možné stáhnout sadu souvisejících souborů naráz.

properties.label: previous
properties.comment: The previous resource (before the current one) in an ordered collection or series of resources.

properties.label: previous version
properties.comment: The previous version of a resource in a lineage [PAV].

properties.label: kvalifikovaný vztah
properties.comment: Enlace a una descripción de la relación con otro recurso.

properties.label: record
properties.comment: A record describing the registration of a single dataset or data service that is part of the catalog.

properties.label: resource
properties.comment: A resource that is listed in the catalog.

properties.label: poskytuje datovou sadu
properties.comment: A collection of data that this DataService can distribute.

properties.label: service
properties.comment: A service that is listed in the catalog.

properties.label: prostorové rozlišení (metry)
properties.comment: minimum spatial separation resolvable in a dataset, measured in meters.

properties.label: resolución temporal
properties.comment: minimum time period resolvable in a dataset.

properties.label: tema
properties.comment: A main category of the resource. A resource can have multiple themes.

properties.label: tassonomia dei temi
properties.comment: El sistema de organización del conocimiento utilizado para clasificar conjuntos de datos de catálogos.

properties.label: version
properties.comment: The version indicator (name or identifier) of a resource.
